name: zzbd_manager_load_zar_file
description: zZbdManager::LoadZarFile opens a ZAR archive, dispatches records whose section prefix has a registered handler, grows the shared read buffer as needed, honors RequestStop, and closes/free-resets the embedded archive.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zUtil ZBD/ZAR manager helper pass.
Binary Ninja records a compare-lowering limitation in the handler-name scan; assembly was used as the behavior source.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4c0400 validates Init failure returning 0, stopRequested reset, record iteration, section name/token parsing from the record path, registered-section lookup, two-phase ReadFileByName sizing/read, tempBuffer growth with operator delete/new, InvokeDataReady dispatch, RequestStop break behavior, CloseAndFreeRecords cleanup, and success return 1.

The native smoke writes a temporary ZAR archive, verifies matching-section records dispatch their tokens and payload bytes through the data-ready callback while an unmatched section is ignored, verifies embedded archive cleanup and shared tempBuffer growth, then verifies RequestStop stops the record loop after the first matching callback.
